title: K01-A-001 Calibration Module — assembly maturity and authority

assemblies.meaning: Full current production assembly before atomic C2R1 promotion.
Full assembly clone with candidate P003/P007. Current geometry/mates/interference were verified here. This is the correct current assembly for engineering geometry review.
Requires P006 service feature/process, seal/clamp/service qualification and P007 structural refresh. The geometry need not be redesigned unless these gates produce contrary evidence.
Created/declared only after T03–T10 evidence closure and controlled atomic promotion.

femm_use.screening: Use the full C2R1 verification assembly as the geometry reference after P006 service candidate readback; derive the magnetic subset and record all simplifications.
femm_use.final_release: Requires P015/B001 production data and final released geometry/input fingerprint. Final FEMM does not require waiting for drawing formatting, but its result cannot release the product before all T03–T10 gates close.

important_non_equivalence: FULL ASSEMBLY FILE ≠ FINAL RELEASED ASSEMBLY. The former is geometric completeness; the latter additionally requires materials, BOM, calculations, process, inspection, service, drawings and test evidence.
